purpose: Define the exact resume-first BR204 FULL178 execution surface without starting heavy compute. Operational authorization is exclusively a later semantic run-key arm commit followed by exact-head manual dispatch.

audited_predecessor.scope: BR204 light preflight plus compact producer/equivalence only; FULL178 heavy excluded

live_main_refresh.execution_freshness_rule: Manual heavy authorize must fetch origin/main and require this exact repository_main_head and MAIN-STATE blob. Any later main movement fails closed and requires a new cold doorstep refresh before arming.

objective_semantics.per_unit_output: exact merged (s,B,capacity) bins for BR202 K8 and BR203 mu plus exact L>8/K8-tail-slot counters; mu bins carry tail-slot capacity attribution
objective_semantics.k8_tail_slot_semantics: For a compact BC state with more than eight exact qBC levels, parts 1..7 are exact and part 8 is the K8 relaxed slot containing exact level 8 plus all deeper-level mass evaluated at q8. Do not reinterpret the slot as only qBC levels >8.
objective_semantics.global_composition: union exact capacities for all b=0..96 first, group bins by exact rational ratio s/B, then solve one descending exact-rational ratio-class LP against the retained envelope
objective_semantics.equal_ratio_rule: Forced tail selection is computed only after summing capacity and tail-slot capacity over every bin with the same exact Fraction(s,B), so attribution is representation/order independent.
objective_semantics.forbidden: sum or average per-b LP floors; order equal-ratio bins to manufacture tail activity; materialize raw 4.1M routing-state JSON; terminal-identity fallback

qbc_tail_certificate.per_b_commitment: SHA256 of the complete validated per-b stream, which includes b/source locks and all TAIL fields
global_checks: L<=8 plus L>8 base-state partition equals H96 compact-state census
mu tail-slot capacities are subsets of mu capacities and mu<=K8
global ratio-class forced-tail attribution is exact and order independent
qbc_tail_certificate.br205_gate_firewall: Heavy result may emit raw and stronger tail-activity candidates, but formal BR205 gate remains false until the heavy result is hostile-audited and separately promoted.

resume_contract.reuse_rule: accept a carried b unit only after exact worker/base source-lock validation, complete TAIL record validation, and deterministic parse; compute missing units only
resume_contract.failure_rule: retain already uploaded valid b-unit aggregate streams for one day and resume from them by explicit carry_run_id

storage_contract.bin_stream_note: The earlier 1.83 MiB preflight covered compact certificates, not transient exact bin streams required by the coherent global LP.
storage_contract.high_mass_scaleout_gate: A single b=96 pilot is executed only after authorization and before fan-out; it is reused as durable unit 96.
storage_contract.projection_rule: 97 * measured_pilot_gzip_bytes * 2 + 20 MiB must be <= 500 MiB before fan-out

authorization.later_arm_rule: A distinct post-audit commit must change only the run-key from armed=false to armed=true, strictly increase generation, and name the hostile-audited doorstep parent/review. Manual dispatch targets that exact arm head.

required_checks: global mu LP <= global K8 LP
post_run_gates.br205_gate: Only after the heavy result establishes exact FULL178 L>8/tail-slot activity and, for the stronger diagnostic, positive forced-selected tail-slot capacity under the order-independent global LP; any formal BR205 authorization additionally requires hostile audit.
post_run_gates.main_credit: requires separate hostile audit and MAIN MIN/replacement consumption; never automatic
